description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Saints WR Chris Olave (illness) is officially active for a Week 6 matchup with the Giants.
items.impact: Olave was able to practice Friday but was listed as questionable to play as a precaution. The Saints will have their top pass catcher active against the Giants.
items.title: Chris Olave (illness) officially active for Week 6

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Saints RB Alvin Kamara (back) is officially active for a Week 6 matchup with the Giants.
items.impact: Kamara was considered questionable to play after being limited in practice throughout the week. Kamara is likely a flex play at best in deeper leagues right now.
items.title: Alvin Kamara (back) officially active for Week 6

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Bears DB Tyrique Stevenson Sr. (hip) is officially inactive for a Week 6 matchup with the Falcons.
items.impact: Stevenson was limited in practice all week and will not be available against Drake London and the Falcons. Kyler Gordon (calf) was questionable to play, but is active and will suit up for the Bears.
items.title: Tyrique Stevenson Sr. (hip) officially inactive for Week 6

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Jets TE Kenyon Sadiq (concussion) is officially active for a Week 6 matchup with the Patriots.
items.impact: Sadiq has cleared concussion protocol and will play against the Patriots after being listed questionable heading into Sunday. Sadiq and Mason Taylor will likely split time at tight end against New England.
items.title: Kenyon Sadiq (concussion) officially active for Week 6

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Colts TE Tyler Warren (groin) is officially inactive for Week 6.
items.impact: Warren was a late addition to the injury report this week and was only able to practice in a limited capacity Friday. Mo Alie-Cox will see the bulk of the playing time at tight end against the Titans.
items.title: Tyler Warren (groin) officially inactive for Week 6

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Titans RB Tyjae Spears (knee) is officially active for a Week 6 matchup with the Colts.
items.impact: Spears was considered questionable to play as he continues to deal with a minor knee injury. Fantasy managers should expect both Spears and Tony Pollard to be involved in the Titans' backfield.
items.title: Tyjae Spears (knee) officially active for Week 6

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Browns RB Quinshon Judkins (ankle) will not play against the Ravens Sunday.
items.impact: Judkins was listed as questionable to play this week and only practiced Friday for the Browns. With Judkins sidelined, 	Jaleel McLaughlin and Audric Estime will see the bulk of the playing time at running back for the Browns.
items.title: Quinshon Judkins (ankle) will not play Sunday

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Devin Singletary is expected to be active for the New York Giants Sunday according to Jordan Raanan.
items.impact: Singletary is part of a backfield shakeup for head coach John Harbaugh after Cam Skattebo's ball security issues, with the veteran to be part of a four-headed backfield attack along with Najee Harris, Tyrone Tracy Jr, and Skattebo Sunday.
items.title: Devin Singletary expected to be active Sunday

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Najee Harris will receive an increased workload for the New York Giants Sunday according to Jordan Raanan.
items.impact: Harris will look to take advantage of increased opportunities for head coach John Harbaugh after Cam Skattebo struggled with ball security, with Devin Singletary and Tyrone Tracy Jr. also expected to be active Sunday.
items.title: Najee Harris to see increased workload in Week 6

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Mason Graham (knee/ankle) is not expected to play for the Cleveland Browns Sunday according to Adam Schefter.
items.impact: Graham struggled to reach the practice field throughout the week for head coach Todd Monken and barring anything unforeseen will leave the Cleveland defensive front shorthanded against the Ravens Sunday.
items.title: Mason Graham (knee/ankle) not expected to play Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: There's reportedly "optimism" Baker Mayfield will return in Week 7 against the Panthers.
items.impact: Mayfield didn't practice this week, but he resumed throwing on Monday. His status will need to be monitored in practice next week.
items.title: Baker Mayfield (thumb) could return in Week 7

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Colts WR Alec Pierce is still a few weeks away from a return to game action.
items.impact: Pierce was able to get out of his cast earlier this week. He remains week-to-week.
items.title: Alec Pierce (heel) weeks away from returning

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Packers EDGE Micah Parsons still isn't practicing yet.
items.impact: The earliest Parsons may return is Week 9 according to Tom Pelissero. The Packers will play at least a few games without him.
items.title: Micah Parsons (knee) not practicing yet

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Jacory Croskey-Merritt has been ruled out for Monday's game against the 49ers.
items.impact: Croskey-Merritt was unable to practice this week. Rachaad White and Austin Ekeler will lead the Commanders backfield.
items.title: Jacory Croskey-Merritt (groin) ruled out Monday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Stefon Diggs is listed as questionable for Monday's game against the 49ers.
items.impact: Diggs returned to practice on Friday. He'll be a game-time decision on Monday, but he seems to be trending in the right direction.
items.title: Stefon Diggs (hamstring) listed questionable Monday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Steelers placed Roman Wilson on injured reserve.
items.impact: Wilson injured his finger last week. He will miss at least the next four games.
items.title: Roman Wilson (finger) placed on IR

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Marcus Mariota has been ruled out for Monday's game against the 49ers.
items.impact: Mariota will miss his second straight game. Athan Kaliakmanis will continue to serve as the primary backup to Jayden Daniels.
items.title: Marcus Mariota (knee) ruled out Monday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Patriots activated A.J. Brown from injured reserve.
items.impact: Brown will make his return for the first time since Week 1. He'll be a WR2 with some risk in his first game back for fantasy managers.
items.title: A.J. Brown (ankle) activated from IR

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Deebo Samuel Sr. has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Commanders.
items.impact: Samuel will miss at least one game as expected. He remains week-to-week.
items.title: Deebo Samuel Sr. (hamstring) ruled out Monday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Mike Evans has been listed as questionable for Monday's game against the Commanders.
items.impact: Evans was unable to practice through Friday. He will be a game-time decision on Monday.
items.title: Mike Evans (ribs/Achilles) listed questionable Monday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Christian Kirk has been listed as questionable for Monday's game against the Commanders.
items.impact: Kirk could make his return from injured reserve. We likely won't know his status till Monday.
items.title: Christian Kirk (calf) listed questionable Monday

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Ja'Kobi Lane (wrist) has been activated from IR, clearing the way for him to return against Cleveland.
items.impact: Lane has been out since fracturing his wrist in Week 1, so it will be interesting to see what his snap counts and route shares look like after the IR stint. The team praised him all offseason and focused on him during his brief playing time in Week 1, so hopefully he will be able to find himself a decent role as the WR2 of the offense.
items.title: Ja'Kobi Lane (wrist) activated off of IR, will play against Cleveland

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Caleb Williams (hamstring) is the starter for the Bears on Sunday against the Falcons. After a few weeks' absence, the franchise QB is back.
items.impact: Williams was initially questionable to play, but the Bears are now planning on getting him back in the lineup after a week of practice where he took starter reps. It will be interesting to see Caleb in a more "regular" game and how it affects the pass catchers, who have only played with Caleb in one normal game, and even that "normal" game saw copious amounts of production from the running backs.
items.title: Caleb Williams (hamstring) starting for the Bears Sunday

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Jalen Hurts (blood clot) has been placed on IR due to a blood clot.
items.impact: At first the Eagles were not going to place him on IR, but after further consultations, they have decided to make that move. Tanner McKee will start in his place for at least the next four games, with Carolina on tap tomorrow. All the pass catchers will likely see a downtick in production, but should still be usable if McKee is halfway decent.
items.title: Jalen Hurts (blood clot) placed on IR

title: Fantasy Player News
